messages.subject: copy files/folders into directory
parts:
Dear All,

I am running unbuntu 12.04 and the shiny server from a usb drive using a desktop computer (feeling it out now and planning on building a full system...). I created /var/shiny-server/www as explained in the wiki step by step article, copied the examples and they work great. I also created my apps using Rstudio on the same computer and saved it into "C://app" under Windows Vista. I would like to transfer these apps into   /var/shiny-server/www so that I could start working with them. Is there a description on how to do this? or could you please provide your insights? 

thank,

Andras

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: copy files/folders into directory
parts:
Andras,

Please refer to the README located at: https://github.com/rstudio/shiny-server, under "Configuration" section.

Note that this document is for the latest version of Shiny Server, and refers to /srv/shiny-server path as the default site directory.
You might be using an older version of Shiny Server. But as long as the path you are using (/var/shiny-server/www) is working for you, you just need to copy your application directory to this location.

Hope this helps,
Fereshteh
